title: Accounts Office Bulletin — Credits Set Against the Amount Owed at Settlement, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Credits Set Against the Amount Owed at Settlement

Bulletin of the accounts office on which credits standing on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions are set against the amount owed when the owner settles in one payment. The recent months are the 3 months ending on the day of settlement.

## Rule

- Where the subscription stands suspended, none of the credits standing on it are set against the amount owed and they stand to the next invoice instead.
- Where the subscription stands active or in its renewal window and a credit was issued on it in the recent months ending on the day of settlement, only the credits issued in those months are set against the amount owed.
- Where the subscription stands active or in its renewal window and no credit was issued on it in those months, every credit standing on it is set against the amount owed.

## By standing

| Status on the subscription record | Credit issued in the 3 months ending on the day of settlement | Credits set against the amount owed |
|---|---|---|
| suspended | any | none — they stand to the next invoice instead |
| active or pending renewal | yes | only those issued in those 3 months |
| active or pending renewal | no | every credit standing on the subscription |

Each credit on the subscription's record carries the day it was issued; that day places it inside or outside the 3 month window.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A subscription carries credits of USD 180.00 issued five months ago and USD 95.00 issued last month.

| Standing | Credits set against the amount owed |
|---|---|
| active | USD 95.00 — a credit was issued inside the window, so only that window's credits count |
| pending renewal, the recent credit absent | USD 180.00 — with nothing issued in the window, every credit standing counts |
| suspended | USD 0.00 |
